Example 2

question.text: When I got home I realised I didn't have my keys. [Generously|^Stupidly|Seriously], I'd left them inside on the kitchen table.
question.modelAnswerString: When I got home I realised I didn't have my keys. Stupidly, I'd left them inside on the kitchen table.

question.text:
A: The company needs to save at least a million dollars in the next year.
B: So that means jobs are going to be lost, [certainly|wisely|^presumably]?
question.modelAnswerString: A: The company needs to save at least a million dollars in the next year. B: So that means jobs are going to be lost, presumably?

question.text: They were [presumably|^definitely|rightly] the best Greek olives I had ever tasted.
question.modelAnswerString: They were definitely the best Greek olives I had ever tasted.

question.text: A: What did you think of the film? B: [^Frankly|Certainly|Unbelievably], I was disappointed after such brilliant reviews.
question.modelAnswerString: A: What did you think of the film? B: Frankly, I was disappointed after such brilliant reviews.

question.text: Bill had a major heart attack. [Generally|Wrongly|^Undoubtedly], he would have died if he hadn't got to the hospital so quickly.
question.modelAnswerString: Bill had a major heart attack. Undoubtedly, he would have died if he hadn't got to the hospital so quickly.

question.text: Carla knew that the suggestion was ridiculous, but [certainly|^wisely|probably] she kept her thoughts to herself.
question.modelAnswerString: Carla knew that the suggestion was ridiculous, but wisely she kept her thoughts to herself.

question.text: Olivia thought, [^wrongly|definitely|frankly], that she didn't need a visa to get into the United States, so when she arrived at the airport they wouldn't let her in.
question.modelAnswerString: Olivia thought, wrongly, that she didn't need a visa to get into the United States, so when she arrived at the airport they wouldn't let her in.

question.text: I'd like to go walking in the Alps but I'm just not fit enough, [certainly|^sadly|wisely].
question.modelAnswerString: I'd like to go walking in the Alps but I'm just not fit enough, sadly.

question.text: [^Generally|Seriously|Definitely], the most expensive time to fly in Europe is during the summer holiday season.
question.modelAnswerString: Generally, the most expensive time to fly in Europe is during the summer holiday season.

question.text: Even though the recording was made over 50 years ago, the quality of sound on the downloads is [presumably|rightly|^surprisingly] good.
question.modelAnswerString: Even though the recording was made over 50 years ago, the quality of sound on the downloads is surprisingly good.
